chunks: It was said to him (peace be upon him): How are you, O Commander of the Faithful?
And he replied (peace be upon him): How can be the state of one whose life drives him towards death, whose healthiness turns into sickness, and who is caught by death from his place of safety.
ai.seo_question: What does Imam Ali say about the fragility of human life and health?
ai.summary: In this profound reflection from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) articulates the paradox of human existence where life is essentially a process of dying, health is a prelude to illness, and safety is a precursor to danger. This saying highlights the Shia scholarly emphasis on *al-fana* (annihilation) within continuity, reminding believers that worldly stability is an illusion and true security lies in spiritual preparedness for the inevitable transition to the Hereafter.

en.sayed-ali-raza: 115. It was said to Amīr al-mu’minīn, peace be upon him: How are you, O Amīr al-mu’minīn?
and he replied: How can he be whom life is driving towards death, whose state of healthiness can change into sickness any moment and who is to be caught (by death) from his place of safety.
